summary: Polomar Health Services filed an 8-K reporting termination of a material definitive agreement to acquire Altanine via merger, effective June 12, 2026. The Agreement and Plan of Merger dated July 23, 2025, as amended, provided for Merger Sub to merge into Altanine with Altanine surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary. The parties mutually agreed the merger was no longer in their respective best interests and executed a Termination Agreement and Mutual Release. The patent license with Pinata Holdings also terminated, with a sell-off period for existing inventory. Watch for any potential new strategic alternatives or litigation.
